sentences.l2: 自己动手做堆肥很简单。
sentences.l1: Making compost by yourself is very simple.

sentences.l2: 把厨余放在一个盒子里面。
sentences.l1: Put the kitchen scraps in a box.
Vegetable leaves and fruit peels can all go in.
Do not put in meat or bones.
Add a little water every day.
Put the box on the balcony.

sentences.l2: 过几星期，厨余会变黑，变成土一样的东西。
sentences.l1: After a few weeks, the kitchen scraps will turn black and become something like soil.
It can be used to grow flowers and vegetables.

sentences.l2: 保护地球，人人可以帮忙。
sentences.l1: To protect the Earth, everyone can help.
